Today's selection covers 84 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 53 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: UK Institute Is Hunting for Dangers Lurking in AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Verizon DBIR: Healthcare Fends Off Increased Social Engineering Attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 9 articles published in the last 24 hours
